ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 18, 2013 and to business minors on Monday, November 25, 2013 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 20 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
